mainEntity.name: I need custom trim installed—what should I do first so I don't waste money on the wrong estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes—most custom trim projects start with a site visit or photo review, then measuring, material selection, and a written scope. For homes in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, the key first step is confirming whether you want new installation, repair, or a replacement of existing trim so the estimate matches the real work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with a site visit or clear photos, then confirm whether you need new trim, repair, or replacement. That keeps the estimate accurate and avoids surprise costs.
